17209.desc:
Five sucking modes, seven vibration modes, and both ends of a 611mm body put to work — the dual-function layout means this rose serves external suction and internal vibration without a swap. The length is the headline spec: substantial, with the working ends spaced so each reaches its target while the middle stays in hand.

@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Premium silicone over an ABS core gives the frame its stability and the surfaces their give. At 50 dB maximum the motors hold to a discreet register through both channels running at once.

@@IMG@@

The battery math favors long sessions: 120 minutes on the USB charger returns 150 minutes of play — more runtime than charging time, which is rare in this category and worth saying out loud.

@@IMG@@
  • Functions: 5 sucking + 7 vibration modes (dual-ended)
  • Size: 611.44 x 60 x 34 mm
  • Material: silicone + ABS
  • Noise: 50 dB max
  • Battery: USB, 120 min charge / 150 min play
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

A long-form dual-ender that outlasts its own charge cycle.

17227.desc:
Red body, ten vibration frequencies, ten sucking frequencies — the spec sheet for this rose reads symmetric, and the symmetry carries into use. Vibration runs one channel, suction the other, and pairing a low note from each produces a steadier feel than cranking either bank to its top.

@@IMG@@

ABS and silicone share the construction in the usual division: rigid where the motors need anchoring, soft everywhere skin meets surface. The red finish is the saturated kind — the color of the category, applied properly.

@@IMG@@

Below 40 decibels, both channels stay quieter than a whispered conversation, which reclassifies the toy from special-occasion to any-occasion. Power arrives over USB with a magnetic charger in the box, so there is no port to cover and no cable polarity to respect.

@@IMG@@
  • Vibration modes: 10
  • Sucking modes: 10
  • Material: ABS + silicone
  • Noise: under 40 dB
  • Charging: USB with magnetic charger
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Two tens and a quiet motor — the balanced build, in category-red.
17227.short: Red rose toy with 10 vibration and 10 sucking frequencies under 40 dB, USB magnetic charging and a silicone-over-ABS build.

17227.tkd_desc: Red rose toy running 10 vibration and 10 sucking frequencies on separate channels, under 40 dB, USB magnetic charger included.

17234.desc:
Suction and tongue-licking share the rose head here, ten frequencies deep. The combination targets the widest part of the market — users who want the pull of suction and the motion of a tongue without choosing between them — and executes it in skin-safe silicone that earns the skin-friendly label.

@@IMG@@

The IPX7 rating is the submersion grade, which places this model in the smaller group of roses that can soak in a bath rather than just survive a shower. Cleaning follows the same logic: full rinse, soap if wanted, air dry.

@@IMG@@

At 50 dB or under, the motor registers as background hum. Combined-mode toys sometimes get louder when both channels run; this one holds its ceiling, which is the detail that keeps late-night use uncomplicated.

@@IMG@@
  • Modes: 10 combined sucking and tongue-licking frequencies
  • Material: skin-safe silicone
  • Noise: 50 dB max
  • Waterproof: IPX7, submersible
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Suction and licking in one sealed head — the standard request, filled properly.
17234.short: Rose tongue sucker with 10 combined frequencies, skin-safe silicone body and IPX7 submersion rating at under 50 dB.
17234.tkd_desc: Rose tongue sucker with 10 combined sucking and licking frequencies, skin-safe silicone, sub-50 dB motor and IPX7 submersible body.

17235.desc:
Nine vibrator modes and nine tongue-licking modes run independently on this medical-grade build, and the independence matters: the tongue can hold its slowest lap while the vibration climbs, or the vibration can sit low while the tongue speeds past it. Fixed-pairing toys cannot do either trick.

@@IMG@@

The full charge takes about an hour and returns roughly the same in runtime — a same-day cycle that fits an evening charge and an evening use. USB handles power; no dock required.

@@IMG@@

IPX7 waterproofing covers full submersion, so the bath question answers itself, and the 55 dB ceiling keeps the motor inside apartment-friendly bounds even on the combined top settings.

@@IMG@@
  • Vibration modes: 9
  • Tongue-licking modes: 9
  • Material: medical-grade silicone + ABS
  • Battery: USB, about 1 h charge / 1 h play
  • Noise: under 55 dB
  • Waterproof: IPX7
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Both channels can also simply run their default pairing for users who want zero setup, which is how most sessions start anyway. Two independent nines — for users who want to set each hand separately.
17235.short: Rose tongue vibrator with independent 9 vibration and 9 licking modes, medical silicone, 1-hour USB charge and IPX7 submersion body.
17235.tkd_desc: Rose tongue vibrator with 9 vibration and 9 licking modes on independent channels. Medical silicone, IPX7 submersion, about 1 h per charge.

17244.desc:
Beating is the second channel on this rose: ten high-frequency vibration modes on one side, ten rhythmic beating modes on the other. The beat patterns deliver short grouped pulses — tap-tap-pause cadences — where straight vibration would just hum, and the contrast between the two banks is the toy's whole character.

@@IMG@@

Soft silica gel forms the contact surfaces, the squeezable grade that warms quickly in hand. Combined with the 60 dB ceiling, the build aims at long teasing sessions rather than quick finishes: quiet enough to forget, soft enough to keep against skin indefinitely.

@@IMG@@

The IPX6 rating handles shower spray and faucet rinsing, and USB magnetic charging tops the battery without a port cover. Between the two ten-mode banks there are enough pairings to keep the tease interesting for weeks.

@@IMG@@
  • Vibration modes: 10 high-frequency
  • Beating modes: 10 rhythmic
  • Material: soft silica gel
  • Noise: 60 dB max
  • Charging: USB magnetic
  • Waterproof: IPX6
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Twenty settings tuned for the slow approach — the tease, done as a feature.
17244.short: Women's rose toy pairing 10 high-frequency vibration modes with 10 rhythmic beating patterns, IPX6 body and USB magnetic charging.
17244.tkd_desc: Rose toy with 10 high-frequency vibration modes plus 10 rhythmic beating patterns. Soft silica gel, IPX6 waterproofing, USB magnetic charging.

17256.desc:
Ten tongue-licking modes up front, seven collision frequencies behind them — collision being the percussive layer that strikes rather than strokes. The two together cover the ground between a lapping warmth and something far more emphatic, all delivered from the medical-grade rose head.

@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Materials are the certified kind: body-safe medical-grade silicone that survives soap, water and years. The USB magnetic charging connector clicks to its contacts from either orientation, and the 50 dB ceiling holds even with the collision layer engaged.

@@IMG@@

IPX7 waterproofing rounds out the spec sheet — full submersion rated, so baths and deep cleaning both fall inside normal use. For a dual-layer toy the noise and sealing numbers are the ones that decide daily usability, and both land on the right side.

@@IMG@@
  • Tongue-licking modes: 10
  • Collision frequencies: 7
  • Material: medical-grade silicone
  • Charging: USB magnetic
  • Noise: 50 dB max
  • Waterproof: IPX7
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Lap and strike from one stem — with the sealing to match.
17256.short: Tongue-licking rose vibrator with 10 licking modes and 7 collision frequencies, IPX7 submersion rating and 50 dB ceiling.
17256.tkd_desc: Rose vibrator with 10 tongue-licking modes and 7 collision frequencies. Medical-grade silicone, USB magnetic charging, IPX7 submersible.

17266.desc:
Rose red and pink are the two finishes, and beneath the color choice sits an unusually complete spec: nine frequency vibrations, nine rotation patterns, and a neutral holding mode, all running from a 188-gram body that measures 195 by 58 millimeters. The weight is the sweet spot — enough presence to feel solid, light enough for extended handling.

@@IMG@@

The rotation patterns are the differentiator. Rather than buzzing in place, the head turns in small orbits that sweep contact across a wider arc — useful where direct fixed contact goes numb, which for most users happens sooner than they expect.

@@IMG@@

Battery details are printed plainly: a 3.7V 320mAh lithium cell, eighty minutes to full, forty to sixty-five minutes of play, and a 58 dB ceiling while running. The magnetic USB contact makes the charging part automatic.

@@IMG@@

  • Colors: Rose Red and Pink
  • Size: 195 x 58 mm; weight 188.2 g
  • Battery: 3.7 V / 320 mAh lithium, 80 min charge
  • Working time: 40–65 minutes
  • Noise: 58 dB max; waterproof IPX7
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

A blossom with its numbers in order — rotation included, colors optional.
17266.short: Blossom clitoral vibrator in Rose Red or Pink with 9 vibration frequencies, 9 rotation patterns, 188 g body and IPX7 sealing.
17266.tkd_title: Blossom Clitoral Vibrator for Women | RoseToys
17266.tkd_desc: Blossom vibrator in Rose Red or Pink: 9 vibration frequencies plus 9 rotation patterns and a neutral mode. 188 g body, IPX7 waterproof.

17281.desc:
The 2-in-1 formula in its plainest form: vibration frequencies on one channel, a licking function on the other, medical-grade silicone around both. No exotic modes to decode — the toy does the two things the category was built on and skips the gimmick layer.

@@IMG@@

The battery numbers favor patience: seventy minutes on the magnetic charger returns about a hundred and ten minutes of use. Runtime beating charge time by half again is uncommon, and it changes the habit around the toy — charge while busy, use at leisure.

@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

The 320mAh cell keeps weight down, and the sub-50 dB ceiling holds the motor below the threshold anyone outside the room would notice. As an entry into the rose category, the spec sheet reads as the version without a weak entry.

  • Functions: vibration + licking (2-in-1)
  • Material: medical-grade silicone
  • Battery: 320 mAh, 70 min charge / ~110 min use
  • Charging: magnetic mode
  • Noise: under 50 dB
@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

The reliable baseline rose — every number competent, nothing missing.

17281.tkd_desc: 2-in-1 rose vibrator with vibration and licking functions in medical-grade silicone. 70 min charge returns about 110 min of sub-50 dB play.

17295.desc:
Ten frequencies of tongue motion, ten of vibration-rotation, and a 500mA battery carrying the load — the Tide earns its name through the pairing of a lapping front and a rotating undercurrent. The tongue side sets the surface feel; the rotation underneath keeps the floor moving.

@@IMG@@ @@IMG@@

Silicone and ABS split the construction along the usual line, soft where it contacts and rigid where it works. The sub-50 dB ceiling keeps the dual-channel output inside quiet-apartment bounds, which matters more here than on single-motor toys: two channels running together is where noise usually spikes.

@@IMG@@

Full waterproofing covers shower play and rinse cleaning, and the magnetic charger snaps home without alignment. Between the twenty settings and the sealed shell, it is built for regular duty rather than occasional ceremony.

@@IMG@@
  • Tongue modes: 10 frequencies
  • Vibration-rotation modes: 10
  • Battery: 500 mA
  • Material: silicone + ABS
  • Noise: under 50 dB
  • Waterproof: fully sealed

Surface lap and rotating floor in one tide — twenty settings deep.

17295.tkd_desc: Tide rose vibrator pairing 10 tongue frequencies with 10 vibration-rotation modes. 500 mA battery, under 50 dB, fully waterproof body.

17311.desc:
Both ends of this massager work, and they work differently: one end is a vibrating insertable shaped for the G-spot, the other a rose head with nine tongue-licking modes for the clitoris. The listing frames it as multiple rose toys in one device, and the geometry supports the claim — two distinct experiences sharing a single handle.

@@IMG@@

Nine licking modes span the range from slow lapping to quick flicking, and the smaller petals near the head add precision contact for clit and nipple work. Premium silicone covers both ends, the soft grade that survives soap and keeps its texture.

@@IMG@@

The IPX7 rating allows full submersion — bath play and thorough washing included — and the magnetic USB charger keeps the routine simple. It ships in a gift box with plain labeling, which doubles as the storage case between sessions.

  • Material: premium silicone

Two toys in one body, gift-boxed — the practical gift that needs no explaining.
